visualCharacteristics.purpose: Full-bleed campaign image with a title and single CTA anchored bottom-center; the whole banner is clickable
visualCharacteristics.description: Full-bleed campaign image; title and SHOP NOW button anchored bottom-center over the image, dark text (#222); whole banner clickable via the CTA link.

contentPattern.name: image hero with bottom content
contentPattern.structure: image cell (desktop picture, then optional mobile crop); content cell with h2 title and a SHOP NOW link
contentPattern.blockContent: Row 1: campaign image (desktop picture, then mobile crop picture). Row 2: h2 title (e.g. "S/S 2026") and SHOP NOW link.

usage: Use for the main campaign banner of a landing page.
reuseGuidance: Reuse for any single-CTA image banner whose text sits at the bottom of the image.
